description: Linting, formatting, and macOS notifications for Claude Code sessions.

hooks.command: file=$(cat | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); [[ "$file" == *.py ]] && ruff check --fix "$file" 2>/dev/null; true

file=$(cat | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); [[ "$file" == *.ts || "$file" == *.tsx || "$file" == *.js || "$file" == *.jsx ]] && command -v prettier &>/dev/null && prettier --write "$file" 2>/dev/null; true

file=$(cat | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); [[ "$file" == *.go ]] && command -v gofmt &>/dev/null && gofmt -w "$file" 2>/dev/null; true

input=$(cat | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null); [[ "$input" == *"rm -rf"* || "$input" == *"git push --force"* || "$input" == *"DROP TABLE"* ]] && osascript -e 'display notification "⚠️ Destructive command detected" with title "Claude Code" sound name "Basso"' 2>/dev/null; true
osascript -e 'display notification "Claude finished" with title "Claude Code" sound name "Glass"' 2>/dev/null; true
osascript -e 'display notification "Subagent finished" with title "Claude Code" sound name "Tink"' 2>/dev/null; true
